title.value: Learning Improved Dynamics Model in Reinforcement Learning by Incorporating the Long Term Future
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper as "LEARNING IMPROVED DYNAMICS MODEL IN REINFORCEMENT LEARNING BY INCORPORATING THE LONG TERM FUTURE."
title.quote: LEARNING IMPROVED DYNAMICS MODEL IN REINFORCEMENT LEARNING BY INCORPORATING THE LONG TERM FUTURE

analysis.description: The research paper discusses an approach to improve model-based reinforcement learning by building a model that considers long-term future predictions. It uses a latent-variable autoregressive model with variational inference to improve long-term prediction and planning. The approach is shown to outperform baselines in both imitation learning and model-based reinforcement learning settings.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments on various tasks, including Mujoco and CarRacing environments, and evaluates its proposed method against baselines.
type.quote: Through experiments in various tasks, we demonstrate the benefits of such a model to provide sensible long-term predictions and therefore outperform baseline methods.

name.justification: The paper explicitly deals with model-based reinforcement learning and discusses improving dynamics models for better planning and exploration.
name.quote: In model-based reinforcement learning, the agent interleaves between model learning and planning.

name.justification: Imitation learning is a key aspect discussed in the paper, especially about how the model helps in this setting.
name.quote: In the imitation learning setting, how does having access to the future during training help with policy learning?

name.justification: The paper's main focus is on building and improving a model for model-based RL that reasons about long-term future.
name.quote: Our method achieves higher reward faster compared to baselines on a variety of tasks and environments in both the imitation learning and model-based reinforcement learning settings.

name.justification: The paper involves building a latent-variable autoregressive model which fits into generative sequence models.
name.quote: There’s a rich literature of work combining recurrent neural networks with stochastic dynamics.

name.justification: The paper uses the concept of Z-forcing in the variational inference process for the latent variable model.
name.quote: In particular, we make use of the recently proposed Z-forcing idea (Goyal et al., 2017), which uses an auxiliary cost on the latent variable to predict the long-term future.

is_contributed.justification: Z-forcing is a pre-existing model and not contributed in this paper but utilized.
is_contributed.quote: In particular, we make use of the recently proposed Z-forcing idea (Goyal et al., 2017)...

is_executed.justification: There is no specific mention of Z-forcing being executed on GPU or CPU in the paper.
is_executed.quote: In particular, we make use of the recently proposed Z-forcing idea (Goyal et al., 2017)...

is_compared.justification: Z-forcing is used as a conceptual tool rather than a standalone model for result comparison.
is_compared.quote: In particular, we make use of the recently proposed Z-forcing idea (Goyal et al., 2017)...
